title: Closed assignment exact-head proof rebinding

non_goals: Leave adjacent backlog or follow-on work out of this plan.

effects: Retain the existing current-and-integrated assignment proof selection.
Allow a closed assignment only when its attempt, run, closeout, prior indexed AW proof, identity, and scope are all canonical and matching.
Keep unbound and distinct assignment-bound proof publications from sharing an idempotency identity.

Rejected, incomplete, stale, scope-mismatched, and ambiguous assignments remain ineligible.
